title: TRACE-CSP: experimental code and results for certified infeasibility diagnosis and a runtime-assurance shield for freeway ramp metering
description: Experimental code and result data to reproduce the experiments of the article 'Certified Infeasibility Diagnosis and Graceful Degradation for Freeway Ramp Metering: A Constraint-Programming Runtime-Assurance Shield' (L. Ouali, M. Bezoui, K. Amroun, A. Bounceur). Includes the integer cell transmission model, the CP-SAT controller, the exact verifier, the interval-reachability certificates, the runtime-assurance shield, the closed-loop harness for the NCHRP I-210 SUMO benchmark, the PeMS calibration pipeline, the synthetic datasets and every result file. Not included: raw Caltrans PeMS data (registration required) and the public I-210 benchmark (revision eb8bbf2, to be downloaded separately).
